description: Returns a published processing time for one form or visa route, category, and office. For US (the default), the USCIS processing-time estimate: the time within which 80% of cases were completed, in months, weeks, or days. Use it when the user asks for USCIS's published processing time for a form. It reports past completions, not how long a given case will take. Pass form, category, and office exactly as the USCIS processing times tool lists them. Every US estimate on file has both a category and an office, so omitting either returns not_found. For GB, UK Visas and Immigration's published processing time for a visa route, as the page words it. Pass the route as form, such as "Skilled Worker", and office "inside the UK" or "outside the UK". Pass the page's section heading as category when the route appears in more than one section. A time the page marks with "*" carries the page's footnote in category_notes. It does not say how long a given application will take. For Visa Bulletin waits, use get_visa_bulletin. Requires sign-in at https://immigrationlayer.com/login and an active plan. Without a plan it returns subscription_required. Limit: 30 calls per minute per account, shared by all paid tools, then rate_limited. Not legal advice. Source: for US, the USCIS processing times tool (egov.uscis.gov); for GB, the UK Visas and Immigration visa processing times pages on gov.uk for applications inside and outside the UK. UK processing-time data contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

category.description: For US, the eligibility category exactly as the USCIS processing times tool lists it, e.g. "Based on an approved asylum application [(a)(5)]" for I-765. For GB, the page's section heading, such as "Popular work visas"; required when the route appears in more than one section.
category.example: Based on an approved asylum application [(a)(5)]

form.description: For US, the USCIS form number exactly as USCIS writes it, e.g. "I-765"; "i765" and "I765" do not match. For GB, the visa route exactly as the UKVI page lists it, e.g. "Skilled Worker".

office.description: For US, the USCIS office exactly as the processing times tool lists it, e.g. "Service Center Operations (SCOPS)", "National Benefits Center", or a field office such as "Houston TX". For GB, "inside the UK" or "outside the UK". Required for GB.

name: get_processing_time

attribution.description: Licence attribution for the source data. Present for GB, absent for US.

basis.description: What value measures, as the source states it

category_notes.description: The source's own note on the category, or null

unit.description: Unit of value as the source states it, e.g. "Months", "weeks", or "Days"

title: Get processing time
